dedupe_keys.name: trafic moyen journalier annuel sur le reseau routier national

description: Trafic moyen journalier annuel sur le réseau routier national is a dataset listed in Tarn et Garonne Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Ministère de la Transition Ecologique. Description Le trafic moyen journalier annuel (TMJA) d'une section routière est obtenu en calculant la moyenne sur une année du nombre de véhicules circulant sur cette section, tous sens confondus, au cours d'une journée. Coverage: Tarn-et-Garonne. The portal files it under Transports et Mobilité. Its keywords are routes, trafic-routier. The portal shows 4,695 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2024-01-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-82amenagement-fr-portal.
